name: Запуск, регистрация и вход

changes.AUTH-01: Fence protected-session UI by transition, principal and role snapshot after async reads. Protected-session checks are bounded and fail closed. Security setup stays reachable before unavailable legal verification. Unknown authenticator-factor state offers retry rather than enrollment; successful factor reload is required before choosing enrollment.
changes.AUTH-02: A lease shared across the full authentication navigation stack blocks concurrent entry methods and navigation. Cancelled provider dialogs release their lease.
changes.AUTH-03: Background public-profile repair, coalesced per principal; SDK transaction skips stale private-profile revisions. Read deadlines for restoration/private profile and legal documents. Parallel protected-session claim checks. Coalesced registration legal fetches.
changes.AUTH-04: Opaque themed field prompts, adaptive link tint, fixed-fill toggle tint, consistent provider order, duplicate headings removed, expandable analytics detail, selected-app-language Apple button.
changes.AUTH-05: Transport/throttling/cancellation/expired-request messages; pending verification rechecked only after actual background return; confirmed document versions retained across failed refresh, while submission remains blocked until successful retry.

sdkAndVerificationLayouts.scope: Real Firebase iOS SDK with local Auth/Firestore emulators and production rules; projection creation and stale-repair rejection.

evidence.startupRoleChecks: Owner/admin security-before-legal, cold offline startup recovery, accessible registration and background navigation checks passed. Final reading-position regression passes with unchanged 3-point tolerance.

finalAuthVerification.scope: Session races, shared authentication lease, contrast, background navigation preservation, owner/admin security gate before legal verification.

securityRecovery.scope: Profile editing regressions and owner/admin retry UI when factor status is unavailable.

evidence.testHarnessCorrection: Foreground navigation test now compares the same occurrence of a repeated organization label. Earlier heading/subtitle mismatch caused a false 22.727-point movement report; before/after screenshots showed unchanged product layout.

visualReview.environment: iPhone 17e iOS 26.5 simulator; debug fixtures and UIKit-hosted views
